reviews_for_site.rules: Verbatim text only. Show first name and last initial. Link to Google for the source. Excluded: the 1 star review, the self review by 'Lee the Barber', and star only ratings with no text.

google.name: Unique D.
google.text: Great environment been getting my haircut there for a while now and always feel welcomed when I come in for a haircut. The environment is very clean and the music is always good.

google.name: Ricardo E.
google.text: Great place! I walked in without an appointment and was helped right away. I loved the haircut, and the prices were very affordable. I’ll definitely be coming back!

google.name: Daniel M.
google.text: First time customer, Dontrise cut my son’s hair(9yo). I have no complaints. He was thorough,professional and made sure he was cutting to my son and I’s liking multiple times. Clean shop. I’m not easily pleased but this was a good experience as a first time customer. They also offer wash and dry services also.

google.name: Lamont I.
google.text: Great barbershop. Dontrise is phenomenal barber. My guy can all types of hair. Patience and his attention to detail is everything. Great customer service.
google.short: Great barbershop. Dontrise is phenomenal barber. ... Patience and his attention to detail is everything. Great customer service.

google.name: Routine Life Fitness
google.text: 10/10!! This was my first time here and I will definitely be returning. Dontrise was professional, patient and very knowledgeable and communicative. My cut was super sharp!! One of the best cuts I’ve gotten in a min.

google.name: Shamarr M.
google.text: Soon as I sat in the chair I felt at home this is officially my go to.

google.name: Wesley T.
google.text: Lee Da Barber the owner was nothing less than exceptional with their service and preciseness of my haircut. I will definitely be booking again !
google.flag: Calls Lee the owner. Use only after the ownership question is settled.

google.name: Basil S.
google.text: Amazing haircut’s the entire shop is sharp

google.name: Frankie
google.text: best barber around 10/10 cut and a got me in as soon as i walked in the door

thecut_drew.name: Tom R.
thecut_drew.text: Attention to detail and communication skills already at an elite level stayed in constant dialogue every step of the cut. Sharpest I’ve been in years, definitely coming back

thecut_drew.name: Alexis M.
thecut_drew.text: It was our first time going to this barber, and my boys got some of the best haircuts they’ve had in a long time! They’re tender-headed, and the barber was very patient and gentle with them. We’ll definitely be back and highly recommend!

thecut_drew.name: Mark G.
thecut_drew.text: Drew has great communication, makes recommendations for your haircut but ultimately gives you exactly what you want. Will book again soon!

thecut_drew.name: Jourdan S.
thecut_drew.text: No cap Drew is one of the best barbers I have met. His attention to detail and the effort he puts into every single cut is unmatched.

thecut_drew.name: Mike R.
thecut_drew.text: Great atmosphere, great barber! Drew is very professional and considerate. Definitely will be going back

thecut_nelly.name: Paul H.
thecut_nelly.text: Been getting haircuts by Mike since 2018 … he cuts me and my 4 year old routinely . Perfection everytime , I won’t let anybody else touch our heads

thecut_nelly.name: Christian T.
thecut_nelly.text: I’ve been around the area for 4 years now. Buddy of mine suggested I go to Mike. I’m glad I listened because Mike has been my barber ever since. Hands down best barber I’ve had.

thecut_nelly.name: Dylan M.
thecut_nelly.text: Nelly is reliable, and sharp. Definitely would recommend

thecut_nelly.name: Jesse W.
thecut_nelly.text: Sharp cut, super quick and cool dude.
